rows.text: With a rustling sound, a nymph crawls out from the corner.
More visitors again, let me tidy up my horns first, crrk...
rows.speaker: Nymph of the Eternal Night

rows.text: Crrrkkk... Long has it been, yet there are still some who wish to tread the path of discovery...
rows.speaker: Nymph of the Eternal Night

rows.text: Answer this one question then, youngling: Under the blades of Strife, how many warriors followed the lance-wielding king in total?
rows.speaker: Nymph of the Eternal Night

rows.text: ...Correct. May glory be with you, crrk.
rows.speaker: Nymph of the Eternal Night

rows.text: Fret not, youngling, and watch carefully — the answer is hidden where no sun may shine.
rows.speaker: Nymph of the Eternal Night

rows.text: Youngling, have you your answer? Under the blades of Strife, how many warriors followed the lance-wielding king in total?
